projects.summary_en: Layer compositing and photo editing for Apple silicon Macs, with Photoshop-style workflows.
projects.summary_zh: 面向 Apple silicon Mac 的图层合成与照片编辑器，采用 Photoshop 式工作流。
projects.requirements_en: Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26+; source builds need Xcode 26+, and PSD/PSB import is limited to 8-bit RGB.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要 Apple silicon Mac 和 macOS 26+；源码构建需 Xcode 26+，PSD/PSB 导入仅支持 8-bit RGB。
projects.name: Compositor
projects.stage_zh: 开发中 · 提供发行版
projects.source_requirements_en: No Photoshop installation is needed. Requires an Apple silicon Mac and macOS 26+; source builds need Xcode 26+. You are responsible for rights to the edited media.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需 Photoshop；需要 Apple silicon Mac 与 macOS 26+。从源码构建还需 Xcode 26+，编辑素材的权利由用户负责。
projects.author: robbietilton

projects.summary_en: An alpha image editor reimplementing Photoshop-style workflows in Rust.
projects.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重新实现 Photoshop 式工作流的图像编辑器，目前处于 alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Alpha downloads are available; check your PSD files and workflow because format interchange and plug-in support remain incomplete.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有 alpha 下载版；PSD 互操作和插件支持尚不完整，使用前先检查自己的文件和工作流。
projects.name: PhotoCraft
projects.stage_zh: Alpha · 工作流仍在完善
projects.source_requirements_en: No Photoshop installation is required. Images you edit need appropriate rights; bundled fonts/icons have separate licenses. ArtCraft marks are excluded from the code license.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需 Photoshop 安装文件；处理的图片和其他素材需有使用权。字体、图标等另有许可，ArtCraft 品牌标识不在代码许可中。
projects.author: storytold

projects.summary_en: Browser-based vector design with layers and editable node graphs.
projects.summary_zh: 在浏览器中结合图层和节点图进行矢量设计。
projects.requirements_en: Open the browser editor; it is still alpha, with broader creative workflows under development.
projects.requirements_zh: 可直接打开浏览器编辑器；目前仍是 alpha，更多创作工作流还在开发中。
projects.name: Graphite
projects.stage_zh: Alpha · 可在线体验
projects.source_requirements_en: No Illustrator installation or original program files are needed. Bring your own images, fonts and creative assets.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需 Illustrator 或原软件安装文件；使用自己的图片、字体等创作素材。
projects.author: Graphite community

projects.summary_en: A 2D animation and motion-graphics editor with vector tools, timelines and expressions.
projects.summary_zh: 提供矢量工具、时间线和表达式的二维动画与动态图形编辑器。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop downloads are available; After Effects project and plug-in compatibility is not promised, and custom shaders are experimental.
projects.requirements_zh: 可下载桌面版；不保证兼容 After Effects 项目和插件，自定义 shader 仍属实验功能。
projects.name: Friction
projects.stage_zh: 提供桌面下载 · 二维动效
projects.source_requirements_en: No After Effects installation is required. Bring your own images, fonts, audio and video assets.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需安装 After Effects；使用自己的图片、字体、音视频等创作素材。
projects.author: Ole-André Rodlie & contributors

projects.summary_en: A CapCut-style browser video editor whose next version is being rewritten.
projects.summary_zh: 采用 CapCut 式剪辑工作流的浏览器视频编辑器，下一版正在重写。
projects.requirements_en: The live site runs the classic early beta; desktop, mobile and automation plans are not established stable features.
projects.requirements_zh: 官网当前运行的是 classic 早期 beta；桌面端、移动端和自动化等规划尚不能当作稳定功能。
projects.name: OpenCut
projects.stage_zh: 早期 Beta · 重写中
projects.source_requirements_en: No CapCut installation is required. Import video, images and audio you have rights to use.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需 CapCut 或剪映安装文件；导入自己有权使用的视频、图片和音频素材。
projects.author: OpenCut contributors

projects.summary_en: A collaborative interface-design and prototyping tool with hosted and self-hosted options.
projects.summary_zh: 提供托管和自托管两种方式的协作界面设计与原型工具。
projects.requirements_en: Use a hosted account or set up your own server; migrating designs requires export and import.
projects.requirements_zh: 注册托管服务账号或自行部署服务器；迁移已有设计需要导出和导入。
projects.name: Penpot
projects.stage_zh: 见官方说明
projects.source_requirements_en: No Figma software or assets are needed. You must export and import your own designs to migrate them.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 不需要 Figma 软件或素材；迁移自有设计需自行导出导入。
projects.author: penpot

projects.summary_en: A desktop suite for offline documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDF editing.
projects.summary_zh: 将离线文档、电子表格、演示文稿和 PDF 编辑整合在一起的桌面办公套件。
projects.requirements_en: Local editing needs no Microsoft Office account; check complex layouts and macros, and use a compatible service for cloud collaboration.
projects.requirements_zh: 本地编辑无需 Microsoft Office 账号；请先检查复杂排版和宏，云协作需另接兼容服务。
projects.name: ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors
projects.stage_zh: 提供正式发行版
projects.source_requirements_en: No Microsoft Office installation or account is needed for local editing. Cloud collaboration requires a compatible service, which may charge.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需 Microsoft Office 或账号即可编辑本地文件；云端协作需要连接相应服务，部分服务收费。
projects.author: ONLYOFFICE

projects.summary_en: A desktop office suite with Writer, Calc and Impress for everyday documents.
projects.summary_zh: 包含 Writer、Calc 和 Impress 的桌面办公套件，可处理日常文档、表格和演示文稿。
projects.requirements_en: Install the desktop version without an Office subscription; test VBA macros and complex Office templates before switching.
projects.requirements_zh: 安装桌面版即可使用，无需 Office 订阅；迁移前请测试 VBA 宏和复杂 Office 模板。
projects.name: LibreOffice
projects.stage_zh: 提供正式发行版
projects.source_requirements_en: No Microsoft Office installation, subscription or account is needed. Install the desktop release for your system and use files you have permission to edit.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需 Microsoft Office、订阅或账号；安装适合系统的桌面版本即可，本地文件需有使用权。
projects.author: The Document Foundation

projects.summary_en: Spreadsheet-style editing backed by relational data, for structured tables and linked records.
projects.summary_zh: 将电子表格式编辑与关系数据结合，用于整理表格和关联记录。
projects.requirements_en: Use the local desktop app, self-host the Community edition or choose a hosted account with plan limits.
projects.requirements_zh: 可使用本地桌面版、自托管 Community 版，或选择有套餐限制的托管服务。
projects.name: Grist
projects.stage_zh: 提供正式发行版
projects.source_requirements_en: The desktop app edits local files. Self-hosting requires a server environment; hosted plans require an account and have usage and feature limits.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 桌面版可处理本地文件；自行托管需要服务器环境。官网云端方案需要账号，并有用量与功能边界。
projects.author: Grist Labs

projects.summary_en: Winamp 2-style audio playback and skins recreated in a browser.
projects.summary_zh: 在浏览器中重现 Winamp 2 的播放器界面和换肤体验。
projects.requirements_en: Open the browser player and bring your own audio; no Winamp installation is needed.
projects.requirements_zh: 打开浏览器播放器并导入自己的音频即可，无需安装 Winamp。
projects.name: Webamp
projects.stage_zh: 见官方说明
projects.source_requirements_en: No Winamp installation is needed. Audio and third-party skins retain their own rights.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 不需要安装 Winamp；音频与第三方皮肤另受各自权利约束。
projects.author: captbaritone

projects.summary_en: A browser recreation of the Windows XP desktop, Start menu and small built-in apps.
projects.summary_zh: 在浏览器中重现 Windows XP 桌面、开始菜单和部分小应用。
projects.requirements_en: No XP installation files are needed; the demo cannot run arbitrary Windows software.
projects.requirements_zh: 无需 XP 安装文件；这个演示不能运行任意 Windows 软件。
projects.name: WinXP in React
projects.stage_zh: 见官方说明
projects.source_requirements_en: No Windows XP installation files are required.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需 Windows XP 安装文件。
projects.author: ShizukuIchi

projects.summary_en: An alpha vector editor reworking Illustrator-style pen, path and appearance workflows.
projects.summary_zh: 重新实现 Illustrator 式钢笔、路径和外观工作流的矢量编辑器，目前处于 alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; test complex file interchange and appearance effects before moving a project.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；迁移项目前请先检查复杂文件的导入导出和外观效果。
projects.name: VectorCraft
projects.stage_zh: Alpha
projects.source_requirements_en: No original commercial application is required. Supply documents and media you have rights to use; bundled fonts, images and brand marks have separate licenses.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需原版商业软件。自备有使用权的文档和素材；附带字体、图片与品牌标识各有许可。
projects.author: ArtCraft

projects.summary_en: An alpha photo-library and RAW-development tool with nondestructive color adjustment.
projects.summary_zh: 提供照片管理、RAW 显影和非破坏式调色的工具，目前处于 alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; camera calibration and some compressed RAW formats remain incomplete.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；相机色彩校准和部分压缩 RAW 格式仍有缺口。
projects.name: LightCraft
projects.stage_zh: Alpha
projects.source_requirements_en: No original commercial application is required. Supply documents and media you have rights to use; bundled fonts, images and brand marks have separate licenses.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需原版商业软件。自备有使用权的文档和素材；附带字体、图片与品牌标识各有许可。
projects.author: ArtCraft

projects.summary_en: An early 2D drafting tool with commands, object snaps, layers and dimensions.
projects.summary_zh: 提供命令行、对象捕捉、图层和尺寸标注的二维制图工具，仍在早期开发中。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; check DWG compatibility and do not assume AutoCAD 3D or industry plug-in support.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；请检查 DWG 兼容性，不能据此假定支持 AutoCAD 的三维功能和行业插件。
projects.name: CADCraft
projects.stage_zh: 早期开发
projects.source_requirements_en: No original commercial application is required. Supply documents and media you have rights to use; bundled fonts, images and brand marks have separate licenses.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需原版商业软件。自备有使用权的文档和素材；附带字体、图片与品牌标识各有许可。
projects.author: ArtCraft

projects.summary_en: A pre-alpha audio workstation with recording, track editing, mixing and MIDI arrangement.
projects.summary_zh: 提供录音、音轨编辑、混音和 MIDI 编排的音频工作站，目前处于 pre-alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; audio-device/buffer selection, MIDI-controller recording and AAF/OMF interchange are still missing.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；音频设备与缓冲区选择、MIDI 控制器录制及 AAF/OMF 互操作尚未完成。
projects.name: SoundCraft
projects.stage_zh: Pre-alpha
projects.source_requirements_en: No original commercial application is required. Supply documents and media you have rights to use; bundled fonts, images and brand marks have separate licenses.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需原版商业软件。自备有使用权的文档和素材；附带字体、图片与品牌标识各有许可。
projects.author: ArtCraft

projects.summary_en: An alpha video editor with source/program monitors, multitrack timelines and trim editing.
projects.summary_zh: 提供源素材与节目监视器、多轨时间线和修剪功能的视频编辑器，目前处于 alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; large-media handling, effect rendering and professional project interchange remain incomplete.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；大型素材处理、效果渲染和专业项目互操作仍有缺口。
projects.name: FilmCraft
projects.stage_zh: Alpha
projects.source_requirements_en: No original commercial application is required. Supply documents and media you have rights to use; bundled fonts, images and brand marks have separate licenses.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需原版商业软件。自备有使用权的文档和素材；附带字体、图片与品牌标识各有许可。
projects.author: ArtCraft

projects.summary_en: An early-alpha PDF tool for reading, annotations, page organization, merging and splitting.
projects.summary_zh: 提供阅读、批注、页面整理、合并和拆分的 PDF 工具，目前处于早期 alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; full Acrobat editing, signature and prepress workflows are not covered.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；尚未覆盖 Acrobat 的完整编辑、签名和印前工作流。
projects.name: PdfCraft
projects.stage_zh: 早期 Alpha
projects.source_requirements_en: No original commercial application is required. Supply documents and media you have rights to use; bundled fonts, images and brand marks have separate licenses.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需原版商业软件。自备有使用权的文档和素材；附带字体、图片与品牌标识各有许可。
projects.author: ArtCraft

projects.summary_en: Transport Tycoon-style transport-company simulation with expanded multiplayer.
projects.summary_zh: 延续 Transport Tycoon 玩法的运输公司经营游戏，并扩展了多人功能。
projects.requirements_en: Use the required free OpenGFX2 or OpenGFX graphics; OpenSFX sound and OpenMSX music are optional, with no original game files needed for this route.
projects.requirements_zh: 使用免费的 OpenGFX2 或 OpenGFX 基础画面即可，无需原版文件；OpenSFX 音效和 OpenMSX 音乐可选。
projects.name: OpenTTD
projects.stage_zh: 见官方说明
projects.code_license: GPL-2.0; third-party components have separate licenses
projects.source_requirements_en: Base graphics are required; use free OpenGFX2 or OpenGFX. OpenSFX sound and OpenMSX music are optional. This free route does not need original game files.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 需要基础图形，可用免费的 OpenGFX2 或 OpenGFX；OpenSFX 音效与 OpenMSX 音乐可选。这条免费启动路径无需原版游戏文件。
projects.author: OpenTTD

projects.summary_en: A RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 reimplementation with improvements such as cooperative multiplayer.
projects.summary_zh: 重新实现 RollerCoaster Tycoon 2，并加入合作多人等改进。
projects.requirements_en: Supply your own RCT2 data files; RCT1 data can add its scenarios.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要自备 RCT2 数据文件；另有 RCT1 数据时可添加其场景。
projects.name: OpenRCT2
projects.stage_zh: 见官方说明
projects.source_requirements_en: You must supply original RCT2 data files. RCT1 data can add scenarios.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 必须自备 RCT2 原版数据文件；支持使用 RCT1 数据扩展场景。
projects.author: OpenRCT2

projects.summary_en: A Morrowind engine replacement with modern compatibility and graphics options.
projects.summary_zh: 为 Morrowind 提供现代系统兼容性和图形选项的替代引擎。
projects.requirements_en: Own Morrowind and configure its data files; check support for your existing mods.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要持有 Morrowind 并配置其数据文件；已有模组需单独检查兼容性。
projects.name: OpenMW
projects.stage_zh: 见官方说明
projects.source_requirements_en: Playing Morrowind requires owning the original game and configuring its data files.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 玩晨风需要拥有原游戏并配置其数据文件。
projects.author: OpenMW

projects.summary_en: A modernized take on classic RTS games, including the original Red Alert rather than Red Alert 2.
projects.summary_zh: 以现代操作方式重新演绎经典即时战略游戏，包含初代 Red Alert，而非 Red Alert 2。
projects.requirements_en: First-run setup can fetch required original assets or import them from original discs; rules and balance differ from the originals.
projects.requirements_zh: 首次启动可按引导获取所需原版素材，或从原版光盘导入；规则和平衡性与原作存在差异。
projects.name: OpenRA
projects.original_zh: 红色警戒 1 / Command & Conquer / Dune 2000
projects.stage_zh: 见官方说明
projects.source_requirements_en: Original game assets are still used. The official installer can fetch required assets on first run or import them from original discs.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 仍使用原游戏素材；官方说明首次运行可自动取得所需素材，也可从原盘导入。
projects.author: OpenRA

projects.summary_en: A Heroes of Might and Magic II engine recreation with modern interface improvements.
projects.summary_zh: 重新实现 Heroes of Might and Magic II 引擎，并改进现代设备上的操作界面。
projects.requirements_en: Supply full original-game data or use the documented official English demo route for limited content.
projects.requirements_zh: 自备完整原版数据，或按文档使用官方英文试玩版体验有限内容。
projects.name: fheroes2
projects.original_en: Heroes of Might and Magic II
projects.original_zh: Heroes of Might and Magic II（英雄无敌 II）
projects.stage_zh: 有发行版 · 原作或 demo 数据
projects.source_requirements_en: Requires full original-game data or official English demo data; INSTALL.md documents the bundled demo-download path. Demo assets provide only their licensed limited content.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 需完整版原作或官方英文 demo 数据；INSTALL.md 说明随附脚本的 demo 获取路径。Demo 资源只有其授权的有限内容。
projects.author: ihhub

projects.summary_en: A reimplementation of the two classic X-COM games with mod support.
projects.summary_zh: 重新实现两款经典 X-COM 游戏，并支持扩展模组。
projects.requirements_en: Provide unmodified UFO: Enemy Unknown or Terror from the Deep data; the Windows installer can import an owned Steam copy.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要未经修改的 UFO: Enemy Unknown 或 Terror from the Deep 数据；Windows 安装器可导入自有 Steam 版本。
projects.name: OpenXcom
projects.original_en: UFO: Enemy Unknown / Terror from the Deep
projects.original_zh: UFO: Enemy Unknown / Terror from the Deep
projects.stage_zh: 桌面引擎 · 需原版数据
projects.source_requirements_en: Requires unmodified original data from UFO: Enemy Unknown or Terror from the Deep. The Windows installer can extract resources from your owned Steam copy.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 必须提供 UFO: Enemy Unknown 或 Terror from the Deep 的未修改原版数据；Windows 安装器可从已拥有的 Steam 游戏提取资源。
projects.author: OpenXcom

projects.summary_en: A Heroes III engine replacement with mods, multiplayer and desktop/mobile versions.
projects.summary_zh: 支持模组、多人及桌面与移动设备的 Heroes III 替代引擎。
projects.requirements_en: Full play needs Heroes III Complete or Shadow of Death data; HD Edition alone is insufficient, and iOS requires TestFlight or sideloading.
projects.requirements_zh: 完整游戏需要 Heroes III Complete 或 Shadow of Death 数据，仅有 HD Edition 不够；iOS 需通过 TestFlight 或侧载安装。
projects.name: VCMI
projects.original_en: Heroes of Might and Magic III
projects.original_zh: 魔法门之英雄无敌 III
projects.stage_zh: 公开发行 · 需原版数据
projects.code_license: GPL-2.0-or-later code; VCMI-created assets CC-BY-SA 4.0; original game assets separate
projects.source_requirements_en: For the full game, provide owned Heroes III Complete or Shadow of Death data. The launcher can import a GOG offline installer or an existing installation. HD Edition alone is insufficient; it is an optional extension with Complete/SoD still required. The official mod directory separately documents limited demo support.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 完整游戏需自备已拥有的《英雄无敌 III》Complete 或 Shadow of Death 数据。启动器可导入 GOG 离线安装包或已有安装目录。仅有 HD Edition 不够；它只能作为可选扩展，仍需 Complete/SoD。官方模组目录另有内容受限的 demo 支持。
projects.author: VCMI Team

projects.summary_en: A faithful Caesar III engine reimplementation for modern computers and other platforms.
projects.summary_zh: 忠实延续 Caesar III 的引擎重实现，适用于现代电脑及其他平台。
projects.requirements_en: Supply a full Caesar III installation patched to 1.0.1.0 and allow saves to be written to its data folder.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要完整的 Caesar III 安装文件并更新至 1.0.1.0，同时允许向数据目录写入存档。
projects.name: Julius
projects.platforms_en: Windows · Linux · macOS · Android · Web (Emscripten) · PS Vita · Nintendo Switch
projects.platforms_zh: Windows · Linux · macOS · Android · 网页（Emscripten）· PS Vita · Nintendo Switch
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 需原版游戏数据
projects.code_license: AGPL-3.0 · engine code; original Caesar III assets are separate
projects.source_requirements_en: Provide a full Caesar III installation from your own CD-ROM, GOG or Steam copy, patched to 1.0.1.0. Julius uses that data directory and needs permission to write saves there. Its code license does not supply or license the original game assets.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 需自备光盘版、GOG 或 Steam 版《凯撒大帝 III》的完整安装数据，并更新至 1.0.1.0。Julius 读取该数据目录，并需要向其中写入存档的权限。代码许可不提供或授予原游戏素材的使用权。
projects.author: Bianca van Schaik and contributors

projects.summary_en: A Theme Hospital engine recreation with modern resolutions and desktop support.
projects.summary_zh: 为 Theme Hospital 带来现代分辨率和桌面系统支持的引擎重实现。
projects.requirements_en: Select your own Theme Hospital data folder; the official demo offers only one level and omits most management screens.
projects.requirements_zh: 选择自有 Theme Hospital 数据目录；官方试玩版只有一个关卡，且缺少大部分管理界面。
projects.name: CorsixTH
projects.stage_en: Released · original or demo data required
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 需原版或试玩数据
projects.code_license: MIT · engine code; Theme Hospital assets are separate
projects.source_requirements_en: Provide legally owned Theme Hospital data from a CD or digital installation and select its data directory on first launch. The official demo is an alternative with one level and most management screens absent. The engine license does not license the original assets.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 需自备合法持有的《主题医院》光盘或数字安装数据，首次启动时选择数据目录。官方试玩数据仅有一关，并缺少大部分管理界面。引擎许可不授予原版素材使用权。
projects.author: CorsixTH team and contributors

projects.summary_en: The community-maintained 3D strategy game with a campaign, customizable units and desktop multiplayer.
projects.summary_zh: 由社区持续维护的三维战略游戏，包含战役、自定义单位和桌面多人玩法。
projects.requirements_en: Official packages need no purchased original game; the browser edition has reduced graphics and no online multiplayer.
projects.requirements_zh: 官方安装包无需另购原版游戏；浏览器版画面有所精简，不支持在线多人。
projects.name: Warzone 2100
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 桌面与浏览器版本
projects.source_requirements_en: No separately purchased original game or disc image is required. Use the official packages; campaign video files may need a separate official download on some platforms. Code, game data and individual components retain their stated licenses.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 无需另外购买原游戏或提供光盘镜像。使用官方安装包；部分平台可能需另从官方补充下载战役视频。代码、游戏数据与各组件分别遵循其声明许可。
projects.author: Warzone 2100 Project

projects.summary_en: Replacement engines that run supported classic adventures on modern devices.
projects.summary_zh: 通过替代引擎，在现代设备上运行受支持的经典冒险游戏。
projects.requirements_en: Provide supported game data or choose a complete title from the official Freeware Games page; check compatibility for your device’s ScummVM version.
projects.requirements_zh: 自备受支持的游戏数据，或从官方 Freeware Games 页面选择完整免费游戏；兼容性需对应设备上的 ScummVM 版本检查。
projects.name: ScummVM
projects.original_zh: 经典冒险游戏与角色扮演游戏
projects.stage_en: Released · compatibility varies by game and port
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 兼容性随游戏和平台变化
projects.code_license: GPL-3.0-or-later engine code; individual game data retains its own terms
projects.source_requirements_en: ScummVM itself includes no games. Most commercial titles require your own supported game data. The official Freeware Games page separately offers complete free releases, including Beneath a Steel Sky; these are different from the limited demos on the Demos page. Extract the selected game into a folder and add that folder in the launcher. Each game keeps its own distribution terms.
projects.source_requirements_zh: ScummVM 本身不附带游戏。多数商业作品需自备受支持的游戏数据；官网 Freeware Games 页面另提供《钢铁天空之下》等免费完整版，与 Demos 页的有限试玩不同。先将游戏解压至独立文件夹，再在启动器中添加该文件夹；各游戏沿用自身的分发条款。
projects.author: ScummVM Team

projects.summary_en: A Duke Nukem II engine with widescreen, smoother movement, quick saves and controller support.
projects.summary_zh: 为 Duke Nukem II 提供宽屏、更平滑的移动、快速存档和手柄支持的引擎。
projects.requirements_en: Supply NUKEM2.CMP from the full game or limited shareware; the official Mac DMG is x64, with Apple silicon builds linked separately.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要完整版或有限共享版中的 NUKEM2.CMP；官方 Mac DMG 为 x64，Apple silicon 构建另有链接。
projects.name: RigelEngine
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 维护模式
projects.code_license: GPL-2.0-or-later engine code; original Duke Nukem II data is separate
projects.source_requirements_en: Provide NUKEM2.CMP from a Duke Nukem II installation. Registered data is needed for the full four-episode game; shareware covers limited content. NUKEM2.F1 through NUKEM2.F5 add optional intro movies. On first launch, select the game-data folder. The official README links a shareware archive and a licensed full-game seller; no original data is included by RemakeList.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 需提供《毁灭公爵 II》安装数据中的 NUKEM2.CMP；完整四章需要注册版数据，shareware 仅含有限内容。NUKEM2.F1 至 NUKEM2.F5 是可选片头动画。首次启动时选择游戏数据目录。官方 README 链接试玩存档及完整游戏销售方，本站不提供原版数据。
projects.author: Nikolai Wuttke and contributors

projects.summary_en: A modern reimplementation of Chris Sawyer’s Locomotion transport simulation.
projects.summary_zh: 重新实现 Chris Sawyer’s Locomotion 运输经营游戏，使其适应现代电脑。
projects.requirements_en: Supply original Locomotion data; the v26.09 Mac app requires Apple silicon and is unsigned and unnotarized.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要自备 Locomotion 原版数据；v26.09 的 Mac 版要求 Apple silicon，尚未签名和公证。
projects.name: OpenLoco
projects.platforms_en: Windows x86/x64 · Linux x64 · macOS Apple silicon
projects.platforms_zh: Windows x86/x64 · Linux x64 · macOS Apple silicon
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 需原版游戏数据
projects.code_license: MIT · engine code; original game assets are separate
projects.source_requirements_en: Provide data from your legally owned Locomotion copy, such as a Steam or GOG installation. Keep original files separate from the application. OpenGraphics additions do not remove the documented original-data requirement; MIT does not license the commercial game assets.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 需自备合法持有的 Locomotion 数据，例如 Steam 或 GOG 安装文件。原版文件与应用分开放置。OpenGraphics 新增内容不取消官方原版数据要求；MIT 不涵盖商业游戏素材。
projects.author: OpenLoco developers

projects.summary_en: Dark Forces with widescreen, modern mouse controls, quick saves and original community mods.
projects.summary_zh: 为 Dark Forces 加入宽屏、现代鼠标操作和快速存档，并支持原版社区模组。
projects.requirements_en: Supply purchased Dark Forces data and OpenGL 3.3; Windows has an official ZIP, Linux uses Flathub, and macOS requires a source build.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要已购 Dark Forces 的数据及 OpenGL 3.3；Windows 有官方 ZIP，Linux 可用 Flathub，macOS 需源码构建。
projects.name: The Force Engine
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 支持 Dark Forces
projects.code_license: GPL-2.0 engine code; original Dark Forces assets are separate
projects.source_requirements_en: Provide your purchased Dark Forces installation. The engine attempts to detect Steam and GOG installations; otherwise select the game-data directory in Settings > Game. The engine license does not include the commercial game files.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 自备购买的 Dark Forces 安装数据。引擎会尝试识别 Steam 与 GOG 安装；未识别时，在 Settings > Game 选择游戏数据目录。引擎许可不包含商业游戏文件。
projects.author: Lucius and The Force Engine contributors

projects.summary_en: An engine replacement for the original Jazz Jackrabbit on modern desktops.
projects.summary_zh: 让初代 Jazz Jackrabbit 在现代桌面系统上运行的替代引擎。
projects.requirements_en: Supply full-game or limited shareware data; the Linux x64 release needs glibc 2.35, while Mac Source Ports provides a signed Universal 2 Mac app.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要完整版或有限共享版数据；Linux x64 发行版要求 glibc 2.35，Mac Source Ports 另提供已签名的 Universal 2 Mac 应用。
projects.name: OpenJazz
projects.stage_en: Released · original game or shareware data required
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 需原版或试玩数据
projects.code_license: GPL-2.0-or-later engine code; Jazz Jackrabbit data is separate
projects.source_requirements_en: Supply files from an owned first-generation Jazz Jackrabbit installation or original shareware release. Complete-game data is separate from the free engine; shareware provides limited episodes. Keep the extracted game files together and point OpenJazz at their directory.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 自备持有的初代 Jazz Jackrabbit 安装文件，或原厂 shareware 数据。完整游戏数据与免费引擎分开，试玩仅含有限章节。解压后的游戏文件需放在一起，再让 OpenJazz 读取所在目录。
projects.author: AJ Thomson, Carsten Teibes and contributors

projects.summary_en: A native desktop recompilation of Majora’s Mask with modern controls and graphics options.
projects.summary_zh: 将 Majora’s Mask 重编译为原生桌面版本，并提供现代操作与图形选项。
projects.requirements_en: Provide your own North American Nintendo 64 Majora’s Mask ROM and a compatible graphics API; Windows, Linux and macOS packages are available.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要自有的北美 Nintendo 64 版 Majora’s Mask ROM 和兼容的图形 API；已有 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 安装包。
projects.name: Zelda 64: Recompiled
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 需原版素材
projects.source_requirements_en: Provide your own North American Nintendo 64 Majora’s Mask ROM. Neither repository nor releases include game assets.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 需自备北美 N64 版《梅祖拉的假面》ROM；仓库和发行包均不含游戏素材。
projects.author: Zelda64Recomp team

projects.summary_en: A community project running the Switch version of Diablo II: Resurrected on compatible Apple devices.
projects.summary_zh: 让 Switch 版 Diablo II: Resurrected 在兼容 Apple 设备上运行的社区项目。
projects.requirements_en: Requires your own Switch base game plus Reign of the Warlock at 1.0.34.0 (tool version 3.3.94012), extracted ExeFS/RomFS, an A14/M1+ device, local building and signing. Older devices need converted textures; select the build for your OS and keep game-derived packages private.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要自有 Switch 本体及 Reign of the Warlock 扩展，版本为 1.0.34.0（工具中为 3.3.94012），并备好导出的 ExeFS/RomFS、A14/M1 及以上设备，完成本地构建与签名。旧设备需转换贴图，构建版本须对应系统，包含游戏衍生内容的包不能再分发。
projects.name: D2R Mobile
projects.stage_en: Personal build and owned Switch game files required
projects.stage_zh: 需自行做包与自备 Switch 游戏文件
projects.source_requirements_en: Your own Switch copy of Diablo II: Resurrected with Reign of the Warlock, updated to console version 1.0.34.0. The tools call this 3.3.94012. PC, PlayStation and Xbox files are not substitutes. Files prepared from your own game: the executable part (ExeFS) and the graphics, sound and other resources (RomFS). An account login or purchase alone does not supply these files. RemakeList provides no game files, keys or install packages. A supported device and a computer to prepare the app. Allow about 5.6 GB for phone resources, another 1 GB for older-device textures, plus app space. A free Apple ID requires re-signing every 7 days and does not enable iCloud save sync.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 自己购买的 Switch 版《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》本体和「术士君临」资料片，主机版本需为 1.0.34.0。工具和目录把它写作 3.3.94012。PC、PlayStation、Xbox 版文件不能替代。 从自己游戏准备出的两部分文件：程序（ExeFS）和画面、声音等资源（RomFS）。登录购买账号不等于已经有这些文件。RemakeList 不提供游戏文件、密钥或安装包。 合适的设备，以及一台处理文件的电脑。手机资源约 5.6 GB，旧设备另需约 1 GB 贴图包，还要留安装空间。免费 Apple ID 每 7 天需重新签名，不支持 iCloud 存档同步。
projects.author: joe jiang (@happyjoejiang)

projects.summary_en: A local-build compatibility project for turning supported Switch games into iPhone and iPad apps.
projects.summary_zh: 通过本地构建，将受支持的 Switch 游戏制作成 iPhone 和 iPad App 的兼容项目。
projects.requirements_en: Requires iOS/iPadOS 26+, an A17 Pro+ iPhone or M1+ iPad, your own game NSP/updates/DLC and prod.keys, plus a Mac with Xcode and Homebrew for building, signing and sideloading. Generated game packages are not for redistribution; compatibility is specific to each game and build.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要 iOS/iPadOS 26+、A17 Pro 及以后 iPhone 或 M1 及以后 iPad、自有游戏 NSP／更新／DLC 和 prod.keys，并在装有 Xcode、Homebrew 的 Mac 上构建后签名侧载。生成的游戏包不能再分发，兼容性须逐个游戏和构建版本确认。
projects.name: nxnative
projects.platforms_en: iPhone / iPad · iOS / iPadOS 26+; Mac · development builds
projects.platforms_zh: iPhone / iPad · iOS / iPadOS 26+；Mac · 开发构建
projects.stage_en: Source build required · author-reported iPhone tests
projects.stage_zh: 需自行构建 · iPhone 测试为作者报告
projects.code_license: MIT project code · game rights and third-party licenses separate
projects.source_requirements_en: Bring NSP files from your own game, with the required updates/DLC, and your own prod.keys. On a Mac with Xcode and Homebrew, the author’s script builds an unsigned IPA locally; signing and sideloading are separate steps. Neither this listing nor the repository supplies commercial games, keys or ready-to-install game packages. The generated IPA includes rewritten original game code and resources: it is for personal use, not an empty shell or free game package to redistribute. This is not a legal guarantee; you must check your rights to the files you supply.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 自备自己持有游戏的 NSP 文件、所需更新或 DLC，以及自己的 prod.keys。在装有 Xcode 和 Homebrew 的 Mac 上运行作者脚本，本地生成未签名 IPA，再另行签名、侧载安装。本站与仓库均不提供商业游戏、密钥或可直接安装的游戏包。 生成的 IPA 包含原游戏改写后的程序和资源，仅供个人使用，不能当作空壳或免费游戏包再分发。这不是合法性保证，自备文件的使用权仍需自行核实。
projects.author: seedds and contributors

projects.summary_en: A Windows and Linux recompilation of the Xbox 360 version of Modern Warfare 2 (2009).
projects.summary_zh: 将 Xbox 360 版 Modern Warfare 2（2009）重编译为 Windows 和 Linux 版本。
projects.requirements_en: Provide a USA/Europe Xbox 360 disc ISO, version 1.0.557, plus 64-bit Windows/Linux, Vulkan 1.2, 8 GB space and a controller. Public matchmaking is unsupported; the original network code has known security bugs, so online play is limited to trusted friends.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要美版或欧版 Xbox 360 光盘 ISO（1.0.557）、64 位 Windows／Linux、Vulkan 1.2、8 GB 空间和手柄。不支持公共匹配；原版网络代码存在已知安全漏洞，联机仅限可信好友。
projects.name: MW2 Recompiled
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 需原版素材
projects.source_requirements_en: Provide your owned Xbox 360 disc ISO, USA/Europe version 1.0.557. The launcher applies title update 6. No retail code or data is included.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 需自备正版 Xbox 360 光盘 ISO，美/欧版 1.0.557。启动器应用第 6 次标题更新；不包含原游戏代码或数据。
projects.author: PaulCombal

projects.summary_en: A native Mega Man X4 recompilation with experimental local and online X/Zero co-op.
projects.summary_zh: 将 Mega Man X4 重编译为原生版本，并尝试加入 X／Zero 本地及在线合作。
projects.requirements_en: Supply USA SLUS-00561 .cue/.bin disc files; co-op is alpha, needs OpenGL and matching releases, and Linux x86_64 needs glibc 2.38+.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要美版 SLUS-00561 的 .cue／.bin 光盘文件；合作玩法为 alpha，需 OpenGL 及相同发行版，Linux x86_64 还需 glibc 2.38+。
projects.name: Mega Man X4 Recompiled
projects.stage_zh: 合作模式 Alpha · 需原光盘
projects.code_license: MIT · original project code; dependencies retain their licenses
projects.source_requirements_en: Supply your own Mega Man X4 USA (SLUS-00561) disc image as a .cue plus .bin set. OpenBIOS is included; a separate BIOS dump is optional. Capcom game content is not covered by the project code license.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 需自备美版 Mega Man X4（SLUS-00561）的 .cue 与 .bin 光盘镜像。内置 OpenBIOS，另行转储 BIOS 为可选；Capcom 游戏内容不在项目代码许可范围内。
projects.author: Matthew Stanley

projects.summary_en: A Pilotwings 64 port with widescreen, gamepads and configurable controls.
projects.summary_zh: 为 Pilotwings 64 加入宽屏、手柄和可配置操作的移植项目。
projects.requirements_en: Supply your own USA ROM and internet for the initial setup; desktop launchers are available, Android is experimental, and iPhone/iPad require self-building.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要自有美版 ROM，并在首次准备时联网；桌面版提供启动器，Android 属实验支持，iPhone／iPad 需自行构建。
projects.name: Birdman64
projects.platforms_en: Windows / Linux · Android experimental · iOS self-build
projects.platforms_zh: Windows / Linux · Android 实验版 · iOS 自行构建
projects.stage_zh: 桌面发行 · 移动端仍属实验
projects.code_license: MIT (project code). The code license grants no rights to the original game, artwork or commercial data.
projects.source_requirements_en: Own USA Pilotwings 64 ROM and internet access for the initial build are required; no ROM is downloaded. The code license grants no rights to the original game, artwork or commercial data.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 需要自备美版 Pilotwings 64 ROM，首次构建需要联网；工具不会下载 ROM。代码许可不授予原游戏、画面或商业数据的使用权。
projects.author: NoahVl

projects.summary_en: A developer-preview iPad port of the Stratagus/Wargus Warcraft II engine with touch controls.
projects.summary_zh: 将 Stratagus／Wargus 的 Warcraft II 引擎带到 iPad 并加入触控操作，目前为开发预览。
projects.requirements_en: Requires iPadOS 16+, self-signing the unsigned IPA, and using Wargus on a Mac/PC to extract your own Warcraft II data into the complete data.Wargus folder. Copy that folder into the app manually; there is no App Store or TestFlight release.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要 iPadOS 16+，自行签名未签名 IPA，并在 Mac／PC 上用 Wargus 将自有 Warcraft II 数据提取为完整的 data.Wargus 文件夹。之后手动复制到应用中，目前没有 App Store 或 TestFlight 版本。
projects.name: PeonPad
projects.stage_en: Developer preview · unsigned IPA · user signing required
projects.stage_zh: 开发者预览 · 未签名 IPA · 需自行签名
projects.code_license: GPL-2.0 applies to the project’s original code only; original game content and third-party components have separate rights.
projects.source_requirements_en: Your own Warcraft II game files, plus a Mac or PC with Wargus tooling to produce the complete data.Wargus folder. Copy that folder after installing the signed app. The free IPA contains no game data and does not grant rights to Blizzard content.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 自备《魔兽争霸2》游戏文件，以及能运行 Wargus 提取工具的 Mac 或 PC，生成完整 data.Wargus 文件夹。安装已签名应用后再复制该目录。免费 IPA 不含游戏数据，也不授予暴雪内容的权利。
projects.author: chrissotraidis

projects.summary_en: Diablo and Hellfire on modern devices with widescreen, controllers and optional quality-of-life changes.
projects.summary_zh: 让 Diablo 和 Hellfire 在现代设备上运行，并提供宽屏、手柄和可选的便利性改进。
projects.requirements_en: Full Diablo needs your DIABDAT.MPQ, with additional MPQs for Hellfire; limited shareware is available, and iOS requires sideloading.
projects.requirements_zh: 完整 Diablo 需要自有 DIABDAT.MPQ，Hellfire 还需额外 MPQ 文件；可使用有限共享版，iOS 需要侧载。
projects.name: DevilutionX
projects.original_zh: 暗黑破坏神 / 地狱火
projects.stage_en: Released · own data required for the full game
projects.stage_zh: 已发行 · 完整游戏需自备数据
projects.code_license: Source available under Sustainable Use License 1.0; redistribution must be free of charge and non-commercial; original game assets excluded
projects.source_requirements_en: Full Diablo requires DIABDAT.MPQ from your own original CD or purchased installation. Hellfire also requires hellfire.mpq, hfmonk.mpq, hfmusic.mpq and hfvoice.mpq. The official guide offers spawn.mpq for the limited shareware portion; it does not unlock the full game. Chinese, Japanese and Korean text additionally needs the project’s fonts.mpq.
projects.source_requirements_zh: 游玩完整《暗黑破坏神》需自备原版光盘或已购买安装中的 DIABDAT.MPQ；《地狱火》另需 hellfire.mpq、hfmonk.mpq、hfmusic.mpq 和 hfvoice.mpq。官方指南另提供 spawn.mpq 的有限试玩方式，并非完整游戏免费。中文、日文和韩文显示还需项目的 fonts.mpq。
projects.author: diasurgical / DevilutionX contributors
